title: Chord Crossing
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \le N \le 10^6; 1\leq M \leq \min\left(\lfloor\frac{N}{2}\rfloor, 2\times 10^5\right); 1 \le Q \le 2 \times 10^5; 1 \le A_i < B_i \le 2N; 1 \le C_j < D_j \le 2N; A_i and B_i are even.; C_j and D_j are odd.; For any i_1 and i_2 (i_1 \neq i_2), segments i_1 and i_2 do not share a point.; All input values are integers.
